interest: Shows 1946-49 postwar Japan fiber trade: a 1949 ramie report, and misfiled 1945-46 Egyptian barter overtures for Japanese tobacco.
overview: This file (decimal 894.61325, covering May 13, 1946 to July 25, 1949) consists of two distinct groups of records bound together due to an internal State Department filing cross-reference. The primary subject is post-war Japanese ramie fiber cultivation and processing, represented by Despatch No. 480 (July 25, 1949) from the Office of the U.S. Political Adviser for Japan in Tokyo, which transmits a comprehensive technical report prepared by the Toyo Sen-i Company for the Economic and Scientific Section of GHQ, SCAP at the request of the Spanish Diplomatic Mission. The second, earlier group consists of a 1946 Division of Central Records (DCR) catch sheet and 1945–1946 correspondence from Egyptian merchants Emmanuel Frankel (The Nile Commercial Company) and Raphael S. Soussi to Ambassador Edwin W. Pauley of the Allied Commission on Reparations, proposing to purchase or barter for Japanese unmanufactured leaf tobacco in exchange for Egyptian cotton and phosphates or as reparations payments.

subfiles.about: Cover despatch forwarding a technical report on Japanese ramie production compiled by Toyo Sen-i Company for SCAP at the request of the Spanish Diplomatic Mission.

subfiles.title: Despatch No. 480 from Tokyo Forwarding Report on Ramie

subfiles.about: Detailed technical report on ramie seed types, cultivation yields, decortication machinery, and spinning and weaving processes in Japan.
subfiles.summary: Toyo Sen-i Company report details Japan's ramie seed varieties, smallholder cultivation, non-chemical fiber extraction, and weaving into suiting, canvas, and netting.
subfiles.title: Report on Ramie by Toyo Sen-i Company
subfiles.to: Economic and Scientific Section, GHQ, SCAP

subfiles.about: Administrative charge-out sheet requesting Alexandria Telegram 55 of May 13, 1946 for transfer between State Department decimal files.
subfiles.from: Mrs. Collins, Division of Central Records (DC/R)
subfiles.summary: Records office note explains a 1946 Alexandria telegram's misfiling caused tobacco correspondence to land in this ramie folder.
subfiles.title: DCR Catch Sheet for Telegram 55 from Alexandria

subfiles.about: Business contact slip listing the Alexandria and Cairo offices of Emmanuel Frankel, Managing Director of The Nile Commercial Company.
subfiles.from: Emmanuel Frankel, Managing Director, The Nile Commercial Company
subfiles.summary: Business card for Nile Commercial Company's Frankel, attached to correspondence on Japanese tobacco imports.
subfiles.title: Business Calling Card of Emmanuel Frankel

subfiles.about: Letter inquiring whether the U.S. Reparations Commission is interested in exporting Japanese and Korean leaf tobacco to Egypt and proposing a meeting in Washington.
subfiles.summary: Frankel asks Pauley whether the US wants to buy Japanese and Korean leaf tobacco for Egypt, offering to discuss terms.

subfiles.to: Edwin W. Pauley, Allied Commission on Reparations, The White House

subfiles.about: Letter confirming a telegraphic offer to purchase Japanese leaf tobacco via cash or barter for Egyptian cotton and phosphates as reparations payments.
subfiles.summary: Soussi urges Pauley to quickly decide on buying Japanese tobacco for Egypt's Turkish-blend market, proposing purchase for currency or barter with Egyptian cotton and fertilizer.
subfiles.title: Letter from Raphael S. Soussi to Edwin W. Pauley proposing Purchase or Barter of Japanese Tobacco
subfiles.to: Edwin W. Pauley, Ambassador, Allied Commission on Reparations, The White House
